title: The Cairn Stones
text: A cairn of stones over a grave by the road, waist high, every stone a different colour. Each traveller adds one, the custom goes, so the dead know they are remembered. The cairn has been growing for a long time. Whoever lies under it is very well remembered.

options.label: Each of you adds a stone for the dead, as the custom asks.

outcomes.text: The cairn grows. Around you the barrows seem to settle, quieter, content to be remembered.

options.label: Take a stone instead, for luck. The dead have plenty.

outcomes.text: The stone is heavier than it should be. It follows you home, growing heavier still.

options.label: The strongest digs under the cairn, to see who is so well remembered.

outcomes.text: Beneath the stones lie a warrior's grave goods, wrapped in rotten cloth.
Beneath the stones lies the warrior himself, who did not wish to be remembered this way.
